question: Estimate the YouTube views of a viral Indian ad commercial in its first month.
idealClarificationQuestions: Viral defined as a top-performing campaign (e.g., a Tata/Surf Excel/Cadbury hero film)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Paid push for first 7 days + organic virality decay model.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Initial paid promotion (skippable + bumper YouTube ads): ₹2-3 cr × 4-week campaign = ~30-50 lakh paid views.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Organic discovery from algorithmic recommendations and shares (if content is genuinely viral): 3-5x paid = 1.5-2.5 crore organic views.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total first-month views: ~3-4 crore views for a genuinely viral ad.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top performers (Cadbury Diwali, Surf Excel #DaagAchcheHain, Tata Tea Jaago Re) hit 5-10 crore in first month.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Initial paid promotion (skippable + bumper YouTube ads)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~3-4 crore views for a genuinely viral ad.

calculationFlow: Initial paid promotion (skippable + bumper YouTube ads): ₹2-3 cr × 4-week campaign = ~30-50 lakh paid views.
Organic discovery from algorithmic recommendations and shares (if content is genuinely viral): 3-5x paid = 1.5-2.5 crore organic views.
Plus shares/embeds on Twitter, WhatsApp Status, Instagram Reels reposts: ~50-80 lakh additional organic on YouTube.
Total first-month views: ~3-4 crore views for a genuinely viral ad.
Top performers (Cadbury Diwali, Surf Excel #DaagAchcheHain, Tata Tea Jaago Re) hit 5-10 crore in first month.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Top performers (Cadbury Diwali, Surf Excel #DaagAchcheHain, Tata Tea Jaago Re) hit 5-10 crore in first month.
